appraisal_events.evidence: Ainsi le silence le rendait fou en effet, par la jalousie et par le remords ... il rêve qu'il surprend un rival auprès de sa maîtresse ... il ne dormait plus un instant la nuit ... elle lui demanda s'il consentirait à pardonner ... il n'avait pas le courage d'aller à Paris sans la voir.
appraisal_events.explanation: Saint-Loup is portrayed sinking further into jealous, sleepless torment over his mistress's silence, even dreaming of her infidelity; when she finally offers reconciliation, he accepts less from renewed joy than from an inability to do without her, continuing his emotional dependency.

status_effects.explanation: Saint-Loup's jealousy, insomnia, and nightmare of betrayal deepen his loss of composure, and even the reconciliation is shown as compelled by dependency rather than as a triumphant renewal.
